sourceDesc.p: Original album forms part of the Thomas Carlyle Papers Collection at Columbia University Rare Book and Manuscript Library

div.p: “Personal to Alexander Carlyle, T.C.’s nephew. Probably done after T.C.’s death.” / the album generally consists of two slots per page; some slots are blank and thus marked, in square brackets / this album contains 84 images
